python3 -c "
import json, glob, os
files = sorted(glob.glob('/Users/chuckcatron/Code/test-ideas/lilbuddy/docs/hook-event-samples/*.json'))
token_found = False
for f in files:
    with open(f) as fh:
        d = json.load(fh)
    txt = json.dumps(d)
    if 'token' in txt.lower() or 'usage' in txt.lower() or 'cost' in txt.lower():
        print(f'TOKEN/USAGE found in {os.path.basename(f)}')
        token_found = True
if not token_found:
    print('No token/usage data found in any event')
"
tool_input.description: Search all events for token usage data
